tasks.label: MoonDog: Update main
args: $r = (git remote get-url origin).Trim(); if ($r -ne 'https://github.com/JHFMoon/MoonDog-Service-OS.git') { Write-Host 'Skipped: wrong remote'; exit 1 }; if ((git branch --show-current).Trim() -ne 'main') { Write-Host 'Skipped: not on main'; exit 0 }; if (git status --porcelain) { Write-Host 'Skipped: local changes'; exit 0 }; git fetch --quiet origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; if ([int](git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD) -gt 0) { Write-Host 'Skipped: local commits exist'; exit 0 }; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; git status -sb
